strings.name: Taavet Hinrikus
strings.role: Wise cofounder; Plural cofounder and investor
strings.summary: Estonian entrepreneur and investor Taavet Hinrikus helped build Skype, cofounded TransferWise (later Wise) with Kristo Käärmann, and later cofounded Plural. His work spans cross-border payments and early-stage technology investing, alongside cofounders and teams.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Former Wise chairmanship and current investing, development and launch, and fund capital and personal wealth are distinguished. Historical biographies and investment views retain their context and attribution.
strings.influence.rationale: Cofounded Wise, advancing digital cross-border transfers and fee transparency and influencing Europe’s fintech startup ecosystem.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: INSEAD identifies him as MBA class of 2010. The listing prospectus says he left Tallinn computer science studies without completing them; a conflicting bachelor’s claim is not adopted.
strings.facts.f2.label: Education and health ventures
strings.facts.f2.value: The 2021 prospectus lists him as cofounder of Jõhvi Coding School and Certific; this does not establish current management roles.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Cross-border payment entrepreneurship
strings.highlights.h1.text: Developed TransferWise with Käärmann and teams; cofounding does not mean personally inventing every technology.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Backing early-stage technology
strings.highlights.h2.text: Supports European founders with Plural partners; fund size is not personal wealth, and investment views are not independent technical validation.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Plural announces new capital
strings.timeline.t1.text: Platform announces €1bn for early-stage and follow-on investment; British Business Bank confirms support on November 16. A team fundraising milestone.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Publishes OLIX investment rationale
strings.timeline.t2.text: Signed article explains Plural’s participation in OLIX financing; total round size is not his personal or Plural’s sole contribution.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Launches Plural jointly
strings.timeline.t3.text: Announces a €250m early-stage fund with Ian Hogarth, Khaled Helioui and Sten Tamkivi.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Steps down as Wise chair
strings.timeline.t4.text: Annual report and register support departure as chair and director; not proof all employment ended simultaneously.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Participates in Wise direct listing
strings.timeline.t5.text: Joins Käärmann from Tallinn for the London listing event; direct listing differs from a conventional fundraising IPO.
strings.timeline.t6.title: TransferWise service launches
strings.timeline.t6.text: His account dates the first version to early 2011, after development began in 2010.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Starts building TransferWise
strings.timeline.t7.text: Recalls developing international transfers with his cofounder; development start is not an exact incorporation date.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Joins Skype as first employee
strings.timeline.t8.text: His account describes joining and helping build products and the company; first employee does not mean cofounder.
